name: Shadow's Edge
text: The general's Sword of Stolen Hours has Crit (Mortal) as well as Crit (Auto-wound); pick one before the attack.

name: Soulfire Ring
text: At the end of any turn, if the general slew any models in combat this turn, Heal (D6) the general.

name: Cloaked in Shadow
text: In each phase, only 1 enemy unit can pick the general as a target of its attacks.

name: Beacon of Nagashizzar
text: Once per battle, in your hero phase, return 1 slain model to each friendly unit on the battlefield.
